specification.name: NCTD Manifest Parser

extends.rule: All v2.6.0 rules remain active except companion identity and visible-name rules explicitly overridden by v2.7.0.

specification.description: v2.7.0 additive parser rules: distinguish PCA from COM/COMP identities, move the visible type suffix to First Name, preserve alphanumeric technical IDs, and retain the experimental Leg ID V2 workaround.

changes: PCA and COM/COMP remain companion categories for trip processing but are distinct passenger identities.
PCA technical suffix is PCA; COM and COMP canonical technical suffix is COM.
Removed generated COMPANION, PCA, or COM suffixes from Last Name.
Visible display suffix now belongs to First Name: -PCA for PCA and -COM for COM/COMP.
Vendor ID uses PCA for PCA and COM for COM/COMP; no hyphen or underscore.
Leg ID uses PCA for PCA and COM for COM/COMP; no hyphen or underscore in technical identity.
PAIRING-001 must pair companion legs only within the same canonical companion class: PCA-to-PCA or COM-to-COM.
Booking Fare continues to come from Amount; passenger type does not force a fare.
Leg ID V2 formula remains CLI -> Leg ID, PCA/COM/COMP -> Vendor ID.
Added experimental Destination column Leg ID V2.
CLI rows copy the existing Leg ID into Leg ID V2.
PCA, COM and COMP rows copy the existing Vendor ID into Leg ID V2.
The original Leg ID, Vendor ID, Tobi MRN, Pair Status and PAIRING-001 behavior remain unchanged.
Added collision and format validation for Leg ID V2.
Added acceptance tests AT-39 through AT-44.
Production use remains disabled until TOBI Stage confirms that the field creates independent one-way bookings.

promotion_gate: Every Leg ID V2 is nonblank and alphanumeric.
Every Leg ID V2 is unique across the post-deduplication Destination output.
TOBI Stage creates Client A, PCA A, Client B and PCA B as independent one-way bookings when present.
Reimport updates records instead of duplicating them.
Passenger catalog and PCA identity remain unchanged.

leg_id_v2.purpose: Provide a different deterministic Leg Identifier for each exported row during controlled TOBI independent-booking tests.
leg_id_v2.scope: valid Destination rows after exact deduplication and after Vendor ID and Leg ID generation
invariants: Do not modify passenger catalog identity or companion naming.
Do not use PULat or PULon in Leg ID V2.
Do not append a counter or random value.
leg_id_v2.uniqueness_scope: entire Destination output after exact deduplication

expected_mapping.client_single_leg: Leg ID V2 equals client Leg ID

client_with_companion_single_leg.client: Leg ID V2 equals client Leg ID
client_with_companion_single_leg.companion: Leg ID V2 equals companion Vendor ID

client_round_trip.client_a: Leg ID V2 equals client A Leg ID
client_round_trip.client_b: Leg ID V2 equals client B Leg ID

client_with_companion_round_trip.client_a: Leg ID V2 equals client A Leg ID
client_with_companion_round_trip.companion_a: Leg ID V2 equals companion A Vendor ID
client_with_companion_round_trip.client_b: Leg ID V2 equals client B Leg ID
client_with_companion_round_trip.companion_b: Leg ID V2 equals companion B Vendor ID

leg_id_v2.classification_note: CLI -> Leg ID. PCA, COM, COMP -> their own already-distinct Vendor ID; COM/COMP Vendor IDs use COM suffix under v2.7.0.

export_gate_patch.when_blocked: Do not produce the experimental TOBI Output file. Continue producing Invalid Trips, passenger catalog updates, and the processing summary according to v2.5.0.

validations_patch.assertion: Every Leg ID V2 is nonblank and matches ^[A-Za-z0-9]+$ when TOBI_INDEPENDENT_LEGS_V2 is enabled.
Leg ID V2 is unique across the Destination output after exact deduplication when TOBI_INDEPENDENT_LEGS_V2 is enabled.
CLI Leg ID V2 equals the existing CLI Leg ID.
PCA, COM and COMP Leg ID V2 equals the existing companion Vendor ID.
Reprocessing identical Source and catalog files produces identical Leg ID V2 values.

acceptance_tests_patch.expected: Leg ID V2 equals Leg ID. All v2.5.0 output fields remain unchanged.
CLI Leg ID V2 equals CLI Leg ID; PCA Leg ID V2 equals PCA Vendor ID; the two values are different.

acceptance_tests_patch.case: CLI reciprocal A/B pair without companion
acceptance_tests_patch.expected: Client A and Client B Leg ID V2 values equal their respective Leg IDs and are different.

acceptance_tests_patch.case: CLI and PCA reciprocal A/B pair
acceptance_tests_patch.expected: Client A uses client A Leg ID; PCA A uses PCA A Vendor ID; Client B uses client B Leg ID; PCA B uses PCA B Vendor ID; all four Leg ID V2 values are different.
All Leg ID V2 values are identical to the prior run.

acceptance_tests_patch.case: Two rows generate the same Leg ID V2 after exact deduplication
acceptance_tests_patch.expected_exception: LEG_ID_V2_COLLISION; experimental TOBI Output is blocked.

acceptance_tests_patch.case: PCA visible name and technical identity
COM visible name and technical identity
PCA technical IDs have no special characters
acceptance_tests_patch.expected: Tobi MRN, Vendor ID and Leg ID use PCA with no hyphen, underscore, or spaces.

acceptance_tests_patch.case: COM technical IDs have no special characters
acceptance_tests_patch.expected: Tobi MRN, Vendor ID and Leg ID use COM with no hyphen, underscore, or spaces.

acceptance_tests_patch.case: PCA and COM same client/time do not collide
acceptance_tests_patch.expected: PCA and COM generate distinct MRN, Vendor ID, Leg ID and Leg ID V2 values.

acceptance_tests_patch.case: PCA and COM reciprocal pairing separation
acceptance_tests_patch.expected: PAIRING-001 never pairs a PCA leg with a COM/COMP leg.
Passenger type does not automatically set fare; Amount > 0 is retained, otherwise 0.

consistency_contract_patch.acceptance_test_id_range: AT-01..AT-52 with no gaps after applying v2.5.0, v2.6.0 and v2.7.0 overlays
deprecated_rules_v2_7: Use PCA as the common technical suffix for PCA, COM, and COMP.
Append PCA or COM to Last Name.
Use a hyphen or underscore in Tobi MRN, Vendor ID, or Leg ID.
Pair PCA legs with COM/COMP legs.

passenger_identity_v2_7.important: PCA, COM, and COMP may share companion trip-association behavior, but PCA and COM are not the same passenger identity.

idempotency: Do not append -PCA when First Name already ends with -PCA.
Do not append -COM when First Name already ends with -COM.
name_mapping_v2_7.note: The hyphen is allowed only in the human-readable First Name suffix. Technical IDs remain alphanumeric.

allowed_pairs: COMP/COM normalized COM A <-> COM B
pairing_override_v2_7.reason: PCA and chargeable Companion remain separate passenger identities.

fare_policy_v2_7.rule: If parsed Amount > 0, use Amount; otherwise use 0.
fare_policy_v2_7.note: PCA/COM identity affects profile identity, not the parsed fare amount.
